messages:
devon: Heads-up — incoming support request from AcmeCorp (ticket #AC-9842). They want per-tenant cost rollups in the Console + a way to click through from a cost line to the request traces that generated those tokens. They asked for CSV export + API access.

maria: Can you paste the exact ask from the ticket so we can scope? Timeline?

devon: Copy from ticket:
> 'We need daily per-customer cost files and an option to click a cost row and jump to all traces for that customer/time window. This is blocking our finance close for next month.'

liam: Sales note — Acme is on a large Dedicated contract and finance is pushing for this before EOM. If we can offer export/API within ~4 weeks, they likely sign the renewal addendum.

sophia: Quick data note: we currently surface token-level charges per model route, but we do not persist a stable per-tenant aggregation keyed to tenant_id + billing_day for efficient exports. Also traces currently have tenant metadata, but there is no one-click cross-link from billing rows to trace search.

raj: Engineering reality check: two possible tracks:
1) MVP (export-first): build daily aggregation job that writes per-tenant rollups to S3/CSV + a read-only API to fetch those CSVs. Add tenant_id to existing billing events if missing. Estimated: 3w (backend spike + 1 sprint to implement).
2) Full Console UX + trace-link: backend aggregation + UI table + deep link into Traces UI that applies tenant/time filters. Requires UI work and some infra to surface stable trace search permalinks. Estimated: 2 sprints backend + 1 sprint UI.

maria: Proposed scoped MVP and launch criteria:
- MVP scope: daily per-tenant CSV export (zip for ranges), API endpoint to list/download exports, basic row-level fields (date, tenant_id, model, tokens, cost).
- Acceptance criteria: exported numbers within 3% of internal billing job, export generation job completes within SLA (24h Max), RBAC so only org admins can download, docs and sample script for programmatic pulls.
- Post-MVP: console table + clickable "View traces" link that opens Traces UI with pre-populated tenant/time filters and a quick-presets dropdown.

liam: I'll present MVP (export + API) to Acme and ask if that's acceptable as a phased approach. If they need interactive drilldown sooner, we'll escalate.

raj: Tech tasks (short):
- spike to ensure tenant_id present on billing events / add labels (due in 4d)
- build aggregation job + S3 export pipeline (3w)
- add read-only API + RBAC (1w)
- UI deep-link prep (add query param support to Traces) (2w)

sophia: I'll mock a minimal dashboard and sample CSV schema by EOD Friday so product can review. Also will add a metric to verify export accuracy vs billing daily.

maria: Action items:
- raj -> scope spike for tenant labels (due +4d)
- sophia -> CSV mock + accuracy metric (due EOD Fri)
- liam -> confirm customer accepts export-first option (update ticket)
- devon -> add these notes to ticket #AC-9842 and mark as product-intake
- i'll create a product backlog card: "Console: per-tenant cost rollups (export-first MVP)" with launch criteria above.

devon: Will update ticket and ping Acme. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy scheduled today 02:15 UTC (no impact expected).

liam: Thanks — i'll aim to get Acme to sign off on export-first today and report back in this thread.

maria: Great. If Acme pushes for interactive drilldown we can evaluate re-prioritization next planning cycle. For now, export-first sounds like a good compromise between engineering effort and customer urgency.
